query: Consider Simply Fashion's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document restrict the use of Confidential Information to the purposes stated in the Agreement?
gold: 2. Potential Purchaser shall not use any of the Evaluation Materials for any purpose other than to evaluate the Proposed Transaction.
rag_answer:
Yes. The Agreement restricts the use of Confidential Information—defined in the document as “Evaluation Materials”—to the stated purpose of evaluating the Proposed Transaction.

Specifically, Section 2 provides that the Potential Purchaser “shall not use any of the Evaluation Materials for any purpose other than to evaluate the Proposed Transaction.” Section 1 likewise permits disclosure to certain Representatives only where they “may need access to the Evaluation Materials … for the purpose of evaluating the Proposed Transaction.”

judge.gold_summary: 协议规定 Potential Purchaser 不得将 Evaluation Materials 用于评估 Proposed Transaction 以外的任何目的。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称协议限制 Confidential Information（即 Evaluation Materials）仅用于评估 Proposed Transaction，并引用 Section 2 说明 Potential Purchaser 不得将其用于其他目的。
judge.reason: 系统回答明确覆盖了金标关键要点，即 Evaluation Materials 的使用仅限于评估 Proposed Transaction，且未与金标矛盾。
